evidence_requirements.description: Release value, prior value and revision from the official statistical agency or central bank.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: figures quoted from the official page
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that the official source was not reached and label values secondary.

evidence_requirements.description: Revisions to prior periods and the measure definition (headline vs core, seasonally adjusted, annualized).
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that revisions were not checked.

evidence_requirements.description: Market expectations if published by a source; otherwise state they are unavailable.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State that consensus is not available in free sources.

evidence_requirements.description: Price reaction window around the release in rates, equities or currency proxies.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: window spans before and after the release
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use dated news moves, label them NOT market data.

evidence_requirements.description: Change vs prior and annualized rates computed deterministically.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Show formulas and mark them unaudited.

counter_evidence.if_none_found: State what was searched and that no contrary evidence was found.

unit_and_period_checks: percent vs percentage points vs basis points

reconciliation.note: prefer the official page; explain differences

stopping_conditions: official value, prior and revision obtained
market window covered or the gap stated

must_state: as-of date and release time of each figure
that expectations are unavailable when no source gives them

limits: no consensus estimates in free sources: say so and do not describe the release as a beat or miss; infer only from prior-period change and label it
market reaction needs the user's own market-data key
correlation in a window is not causation
